theorems.name: Submission.ind_ae_integer_multiplicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
